notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.

event.text: Call 911 now, or have someone take you to the nearest emergency department immediately — do not drive yourself. A sudden 'worst ever' headache with new neck stiffness needs urgent emergency brain imaging to rule out bleeding around the brain. If anyone is with you, ask them to stay with you and to call 911 if it has not been called, or to tell the dispatcher or staff right away if you become drowsy, confused, faint, have a seizure, vomit, or develop weakness or speech trouble.
